title: Jom Maandeeji jeenay
intro: Limre ummii ko e fuɗɗoode ɓurnde famɗude, e daɗndo winndaango e yiɗde Alla. Suuɗnde e nder cukaagu mum, umminde e nder galleeji laamɗo oo tigi rigi yiɗde halkude leñol mum en, ooɗoo ruuhu noon, haa jooni noddaama e golle doole. Alaa ko ɓe njogii so wonaa goonɗinal e sawru duroowo lesɗikiniiɗo, ɓe ndarii yeeso laamɗo ɓurɗo doole e yonta oo, ɓe ɗaɓɓiri ndimaagu maccuɓe ɓee. Aduna o e hoore mum wayi ko no diwde e yamiroore maɓɓe — ndiyam ceerti, asamaan haali, laamu yani.
clues: Balɗe am gadane ɗee ko kulol — cukalel hono am ina doga e jibinannde mum, laamɗo mo yurmeende mum alaa, kulɗo ko arata.
Mi hisnaama e ndiyam, mi ummiima e nder galle laamɗo oo tigi ɗaɓɓoowo halkaare am.
Mi dogi leydi am caggal nde keɓ-mi huunde nde alaa ɗo haaɗi, mi wonti gaynaako lesɗikiniiɗo e leydi woɗɗundi.
Mi artii ngam haɓaade oon laamɗo doole e sawru laaɓtundu e nulal laaɓtungal, ɗaɓɓoowo ndimaagu leñol am.
Mi renndini ndiyam mawɗam wonande rewooɓe mi ɓee, miɗo ndaara no ɗiin ndiyam ɓuuɓnirta gaño am oo fof.
Mi ƴeeŋii dow tulde ceniinde ngam heɓde ardorde Alla, mi rokkaama maandeeji jeenay laaɓtuɗi ngam seedaade goonga.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
